text.en:
Items (a) and (d) under Group IV, for the Province of Cebu page 341, paragraph c, Section two of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-seven hundred and one is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(a) For the construction, repair and/or improvement of provincial, municipal and/or barrio roads and other public works projects situated in the Municipality of Sibonga, Cebu ₱40,000.00 "(d) For the construction, repair and/or improvement of provincial, municipal and/or barrio roads and other public works projects situated in the Municipality of Alcoy, Cebu 30,000.00."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
